reason: This is an entirely new, opt-in DataLocalization module with its own document store, permissions, and services; existing behavior is unaffected except for minor additive changes to shared csproj/sln files, though there is a bug (JsonArray indexed with a string key in AllDataTranslationsDeploymentSource) that would break the new export feature but not existing functionality.
